title: EcoVacs W2S Pro Omni window-cleaning robot: Launch date, price, features
excerpt: Finally, a robot that judges your streaky windows so you don't have to.
content_html:
TL;DR: EcoVacs is launching the W2S Pro Omni, a window-cleaning robot with edge detection, a portable multi-purpose charging dock, and 12-tier suction protection to keep it safely attached to glass. It launches Aug. 10, priced at $599.99.

Robot vacuums have solved floor cleaning, but there's always a stubborn gap left behind: floor-to-ceiling windows, big glass panels, and sliding doors that don't get cleaned as often as they should. EcoVacs is calling this the "last dirty inch" problem, and it's tackling it with the launch of the W2S Pro Omni, a dedicated window-cleaning robot. This new model launches on Aug. 10 for $599.99.

Credit: Ecovacs

Credit: Ecovacs

The core feature here is what Ecovacs calls TruEdge 2.0 — high-density felt bristles set in an eight-tooth radial layout, designed to reach into corners and edges rather than just wiping down the flat middle of a window and calling it done. That's paired with a dual-side 6-jet spray system to help loosen stuck-on dirt and stains.

Mashable Trend Report

You May Also Like

One of the more practical upgrades is the all-in-one multi-purpose dock. It doubles as a control panel, a charger (rated for 110 minutes of runtime), and portable storage, so instead of needing an outlet near whatever window you're cleaning, the power source essentially travels with the robot.

Credit: Ecovacs

Safety is a big focus, too. EcoVacs packed in a bunch of protection features — strong suction, pressure sensors, and edge detection — all working together to keep the robot securely stuck to the glass. Even if the battery gets low mid-clean, EcoVacs says it's designed to stay attached to the window for 30 minutes rather than risk falling off.

Windows, meet your match — the W2S Pro Omni arrives Aug. 10.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR：EcoVacs 正在推出 W2S Pro Omni，这是一款具有边缘检测功能的窗户清洁机器人、便携式多用途充电底座和 12 层吸力保护装置，可使其安全地附着在玻璃上。 它于 8 月 10 日上市，售价 599.99 美元。

机器人吸尘器已经解决了地板清洁问题，但总是留下一个顽固的空白：落地窗、大玻璃板和滑动门没有得到应有的经常清洁。 EcoVacs 将此称为“最后一英寸脏”问题，并通过推出专用窗户清洁机器人 W2S Pro Omni 来解决这个问题。 这款新型号将于 8 月 10 日上市，售价 599.99 美元。

图片来源：科沃斯

图片来源：科沃斯

这里的核心功能是科沃斯所说的 TruEdge 2.0——高密度毛毡刷毛设置在八齿径向布局中，旨在到达角落和边缘，而不是仅仅擦拭窗户的平坦中间就完成了。 搭配双面 6 喷头喷雾系统，有助于松开粘附的污垢和污渍。

可混搭趋势报告

你可能也喜欢

更实用的升级之一是一体化多功能底座。 它兼作控制面板、充电器（额定运行时间为 110 分钟）和便携式存储设备，因此不需要在您要清洁的任何窗户附近安装插座，电源基本上可以随机器人一起移动。

图片来源：科沃斯

安全也是一个重点。 EcoVacs 具有一系列保护功能——强大的吸力、压力传感器和边缘检测——所有这些功能共同作用，使机器人牢固地粘在玻璃上。 EcoVacs 表示，即使电池在清洁过程中电量不足，它的设计也能在窗户上保持 30 分钟，而不会有掉落的风险。

Windows，与您的对手见面 — W2S Pro Omni 将于 8 月 10 日上市。
